text:
anya: Quick thread to finalize GA gating. We need final language for SLA applicability, an observability smoke checklist, billing-adjudication flow, and docs for private (air-gapped) installs. Who picks each?

maya: I want explicit separation: what we promise in Hosted GA vs Dedicated contractual SLAs. Also need a single source of truth for accepted exceptions.

eli: I'll author the SLA applicability paragraph and a tiny interpolation table: model_family | max_tokens | covered (yes/no) | p99_target. ETA: Tue EOD. Will exclude non-verified and >1024 tokens by default.

robin: I'll pair with Eli on the interpolation table; will add a "degradation plan" column (fallback model / soft-throttle).

sophia: Docs: I'll produce a private-install checklist covering KMS/HSM integration, log-forwarding, and audit retention. Also add an air-gapped install note (manual image import steps). ETA: Wed AM.

noah: Ops: billing-adjudication flow proposals: 1) customer submits dispute -> 24h ack by billing-oncall, 2) gather per-route usage + trace, 3) product policy decides exceptions within 72h, 4) finance issues credits. I'll draft a short policy doc.

finance-bot: For pilot burst credits we need explicit consumption rules and expiry: propose "pilot credits are promotional; they do not accrue and expire with 30 days' notice." Also need example calc tables.

legal-bot: Agree with non-absolute promises on Hosted. For Dedicated include contractual uptime/latency tiers and a capped credit schedule. We'll review Eli's draft once available.

anya: Observability smoke checklist (my draft):
- synthetic p99 latency probe at 1m cadence for top-5 routes
- token-cost-per-minute metric with 1m/5m windows + alert if >30% spike
- client-visible error-rate alert >0.5% over 5m
- rollout correlation dashboard (model -> deploy -> latency)
- oncall runbook linked to each alert
Who will turn these into actionable alerts?

eli: I'll hook the synthetic p99 probes and rollout correlation dashboard. Runbook: 1) validate probe, 2) check recent rollout, 3) rollback candidate, 4) scale or page eng-runtime. I'll attach runbook to alerts.

robin: I'll own token-cost instrumentation per-route and a quick ops dashboard so billing-oncall can triage disputes faster.

sophia: Docs will reference the observability checklist and include sample queries for audit logs and token-cost lookups. I'll add a troubleshooting appendix mapping alerts to troubleshooting steps.

maya: Acceptance gate for me: (A) SLA text in repo + legal ack, (B) private-install guide merged, (C) alerts live with runbooks, (D) billing-adjudication doc + finance signoff, (E) staging smoke run green. Reply with "ack + ETA".

eli: ack Tue EOD (SLA draft).

robin: ack Wed EOD (degradation plan + cost dashboard).

sophia: ack Wed AM (docs PR).

noah: ack Fri noon (billing flow doc and ops playbook).

finance-bot: ack Thu EOD (burst-credit docs + calc).

legal-bot: ack 48h after Eli posts draft.

deploy-bot: Reminder: staging smoke window scheduled 2025-11-05T10:00Z, includes synthetic p99 checks and billing smoke. :robot_face:

anya: Great. If anyone needs to hand off, flag here now. Otherwise I'll track these into the launch checklist and mark owners. Thanks! :rocket:
